# ZOE — account brief

## Who

ZOE runs personalized nutrition programs built on science, with at-home testing and daily guidance in the app ([source](https://joinzoe.com/)). Its GitHub org is joinzoe, linked to joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).

## Production Expo signals

- eas.json is present in joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- package.json lists react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 16 public repos and 88 followers ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).
- The org description names a regulated category, health ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).
- The App Store listing has 22,000 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)).
- There were 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@joinzoe-maintainer-1), 121 commits, top contributor to joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company ZOE, location Remote, website https://joinzoe.com, and bio "Mobile engineer at ZOE. Maintains the ZOE app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@joinzoe-maintainer-2), 70 commits ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company ZOE, location New York, NY, website https://joinzoe.com, and bio "React Native developer on the ZOE mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the ZOE app." ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@joinzoe-maintainer-3), 28 commits ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company ZOE, location San Francisco, CA, website https://joinzoe.com, and bio "Engineer at ZOE. Mostly the ZOE app, sometimes the API." ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-3)).

## Why now

joinzoe/zoe-app was last pushed 2026-08-17 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app)), and the App Store listing shows 8 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)). The app is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer Two, your profile says you handle EAS builds and releases for the ZOE app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)). The store listing shows 8 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)), and the repo has CI workflows alongside its eas.json ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)). At that release rate, where does your EAS build and submit pipeline take the most hands-on time?
